name: cuopt-lp-autotuner
description: Evolve policies for LP solver optimization: transforms, parameters, and batching

problem.goal: Maximize LP solver throughput and minimize p95 latency on GPU
problem.output: Optimal solver configuration for each LP instance

evaluation.notes: Fitness combines throughput, latency, and correctness. Hard constraint: no >2% p95 regression vs baseline.

optimization_strategies.name: scaling_transforms
optimization_strategies.description: Enable row/column equilibration scaling to improve numerical conditioning
optimization_strategies.hint: Geometric mean scaling often helps for poorly conditioned matrices

optimization_strategies.name: reordering_transforms
optimization_strategies.description: Reorder rows/columns for better cache locality and pivot selection
optimization_strategies.hint: Try degree-based ordering, RCM, or minimum degree

optimization_strategies.name: bound_tightening
optimization_strategies.description: Tighten variable bounds using simple constraint propagation
optimization_strategies.hint: Safe for single-variable constraints; be careful with general propagation

optimization_strategies.name: solver_tolerance
optimization_strategies.description: Adjust solver tolerance for speed vs accuracy tradeoff
optimization_strategies.hint: Looser tolerance (1e-4) can be faster but may affect solution quality

optimization_strategies.name: batching_strategy
optimization_strategies.description: Group similar-sized LPs for efficient GPU batching
optimization_strategies.hint: Homogeneous batches by size or density reduce memory fragmentation

optimization_strategies.name: feature_conditioned
optimization_strategies.description: Select transforms based on LP features (size, density, numerical range)
optimization_strategies.hint: Large sparse LPs may need different treatment than small dense ones

constraints: Policy must not regress p95 latency on TEST by more than 2% vs baseline
All transforms must be solution-preserving (invertible or equivalent)
Policy must maintain correctness: objective within 1e-4 relative tolerance
Fail rate must not exceed baseline fail rate
Policy representation must be human-readable JSON (no neural networks)
references: Interior Point Methods for Large-Scale LP (Wright)
